posts.title: We Retired Early. Why Do We Still Worry About Money?
posts.description: We retired early with $2.7 million, moved to Portugal, and watched our net worth fall $500,000. Four years later, why does spending money still scare me?

posts.title: We Retired Early and Moved to Portugal. Here’s What Our Life Actually Costs.
posts.description: Our family of four spends about €10,300 to €10,700 a month in Portugal. Here’s the real breakdown, from international school and housing to groceries, healthcare and travel.

posts.title: Portugal’s Real Estate Market Has a Transparency Problem
posts.description: After buying a home in Portugal, I think buyers deserve clearer information about prices, agent incentives and the risks behind a beautiful listing.
